atAGlance: Cà phê espresso is the modern café shortcut for a sharp coffee hit, often still carrying Vietnam’s firm robusta bitterness.
whatItIs: Cà phê espresso is a small espresso shot or espresso-based café order. Expect a short, sharp espresso-style coffee with concentrated roast and very little sweetness unless added.
howToEnjoy: Order it when you want a quick coffee hit rather than a sweet phin drink.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê espresso is a more international café order, but sweetness can still be higher than expected. Ask hot or iced, then say less sweet if chocolate, milk, or syrup is involved.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê espresso is more common in modern cafés than street stalls, but it helps travelers decode urban coffee menus.
goodToKnow: It may still use Vietnamese robusta, so expect a firm bitter edge.
